jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Managed Services
jobs_results.description:
WatchGuard embraces a Flexible Work Philosophy. Most of our employees can choose to work from the office, at home, or any combination of the two. We’ve built a global workforce of outstanding team members and a flexible culture built on trust, collaboration, and belonging.

Enter the exciting world of cybersecurity. WatchGuard has been protecting businesses against cyber criminals, malware, adware, spam, and accidental exposures for over 25 years. Every one of us depend on the internet for information, communication, e-commerce, and entertainment. WatchGuard has and will continue to develop solutions to combat ever changing cyber-threats. Join WatchGuard in this fight to keep our customer’s safe from the perils of the internet.

About the Position

The Project Management position will play a key role in expanding WatchGuard’s new Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service to our customers. The ideal candidate will be a strong project manager and have managed project teams comprised... of both local and global resources. They will also have had experience working and managing in an environment with managed services providers or have worked as a project manager for a managed services vendor. They must be comfortable working in a dynamic organization with high delivery and quality demands.

The right candidate has strong communication and interpersonal skills, time management skills, and can develop an acute understanding how the department and project fits into the broader organization. This is a great opportunity for someone who has a broad technical knowledge, can see applications and systems from a service delivery perspective, and make sound project decisions. A successful candidate will build cross-functional partnerships with Product Management, Engineering, and Product Marketing to enable successful delivery of managed services across the entire enterprise.

This role reports directly to the Vice President of Product Delivery Operations and is part of a supportive, experienced team. If you are looking for a challenge and you’re enthusiastic, self-motivated, and want to grow your program management career, WatchGuard has the perfect role for you.

A day in the life… You will likely have e-mail from your world-wide teammates when you start your day. You tackle your e-mail and participate in meetings using Microsoft Teams or Zoom when scheduled. As a Project Manager, you will likely be hosting or leading some of these meetings. You will likely arrange calls with key members of your team to understand their status, challenges, and risks. You will be updating the status of your projects primarily using Confluence and Jira, but also in Excel or PowerPoint when appropriate. You will arrange time for product learning either through hands-on training or internal websites, videos, and documentation. At the end of the day, you reflect on the progress made as well as new risks and challenges identified; but you recognize the importance of your engagement in moving your programs towards its goals.

Position Responsibilities
• Lead the planning and implementation of projects, defining project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
• Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets, tracking progress and adjusting timelines as necessary.
• Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path, proactively resolving issues and mitigating risks.
• Coordinate resources, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to ensure efficient project execution.
• Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among team members, clients, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
• Monitor and report on project progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders and senior management.
• Identify roadblocks, issues and anticipate risks that may inhibit overall project progress and/or release success and report/escalate them to the appropriate stakeholder(s)
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality standards throughout the project lifecycle.
• Contribute to a positive team environment where equity and inclusion are highly valued.

Requirements
• Proven experience as a Project Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
• Strong understanding of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and motivate team members.
• Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on achieving results.
• Proficiency in project management software and tools and techniques
• Experience in managed services industry is a plus.
• Fluent in Spanish and English
• Preferred work location: Bilbao area

Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values: Accountability, Community, Belonging, Action, Innovation, and Customer-Centric. Learn more about our company culture at www.watchguard.com/wgrd-careers.

WatchGuard provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified employees, regardless of their race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, creed, pregnancy, age, sex, sexual orientation (including gender expression or identity), marital status, mental or physical disability, honorably discharged veteran or military status or any other category protected by federal, state or local laws. Our equal employment opportunity (or EEO) policy focuses solely on the talent, hard work, contributions, and actual results achieved by each WatchGuard employee and on the potential of employment candidates to make such contributions. We consider focusing on an employee's protected characteristics rather than on talent, hard work, and actual work results to violate our EEO policy. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to a diverse workforce. WatchGuard participates in E-verify.

WatchGuard is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability

jobs_results.title: Information Security Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Verisure is a global leading provider of professionally monitored security solutions. We are an international company with a start-up mindset, fast, agile and lean, high performance and value driven.

The Verisure Group creates services and products for smarter, safer and more secure homes, serving customers throughout Europe and LatAm. 

The Verisure Information Security team is currently seeking a talented, innovative, passionate Information Security Project and Demand Manager to support our growing on a group wide basis. Reporting to the Programme Manager, the Information Security Project and Demand Manager will be a member of the Information Security team with a responsibility to deliver our Security projects/initiatives.

Responsibilities

Working within a Global organization, this role will be responsible for coordinating activities across the region for our Information Security initiatives and demands from the Technologies and Business areas, interfacing with key stakeholders... to ensure the effective delivery of results.

A successful candidate will need to have significant drive, an analytical and organized mindset with the ability to contribute to the continuous development and implementation of our project/initiative competencies and methodologies.

As part of this role, the candidate will work with experts from all aspects of our exciting business with the primary goal of delivering projects/initiatives on time, on budget with high customer satisfaction.

Main Responsibilities:
• Works closely with Information Security teams in delivering projects/initiatives, using various methodologies.
• Tracking objectives and key results.
• Lead projects’ meetings and handle the project status reporting/dashboards to the teams and upper management.
• Oversee the execution of the strategic and operational plans. ​
• Demand management from different stakeholders (Technology and Business areas)​.
• Work collaboratively with stakeholders, from across the business.
• Manage internal and external communication and maintain good working relationships with stakeholders within the project.
• Support Programme Manager in the budget and procurement processes.
• Continuously work with improvement within the organization.

What you bring

To be successful in this role, you will need to be an engaged, structured person with an open mindset and excellent communication skills. Open to change, enjoy working in a team, collaborate and respect the views of others.

Required Experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of consistent track record within Project Management
• Lead in an agile way with an international mindset
• Good organizational skills, able to handle multiple running projects/initiatives
• Written and Spoken Fluency in English

Desired Experience:
• Relevant Project Management/Agile certification (e.g. PMP, Scrum Master, Product Owner, SaFe)
• Experience with Cyber security tools and IoT (particularly smart home)

Verisure

We believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place.

Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people, we offer a great opportunity to personal development with an environment characterized by humbleness and knowledge sharing and to enhance the on the job training we have a training budget to ensure personal growth.

We are looking forward to your application

jobs_results.title: Project Manager at SYSTEM ENGINEERING ML for projects
jobs_results.description:
Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens. As a leader in transport solutions for more than 160 years, Siemens Mobility is constantly innovating its portfolio in its core areas of rolling stock, rail automation and electrification, turnkey systems, intelligent traffic systems as well as related services. With digitalization, Siemens Mobility is enabling mobility operators worldwide to make infrastructure intelligent, increase value sustainably over the entire lifecycle, enhance passenger experience and guarantee availability.

Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects & Electrification, Mainline Transport, Urban Transport and Customer Services. They have the know-how to make road traffic flow more smoothly and quickly, make trains more environmentally friendly and efficient, make train schedules and freight shipments more reliable. We work with our customers to develop optimal solutions to help overcome their challenges.

We want to join a Project Manager at SYSTEM... ENGINEERING ML for projects

Reporting to the Head of System Engineering Management ML Area for bids and projects, this role drives a team of signaling system engineers working for ML projects.

Is it of upmost importance its contribution to the System and product strategy as System engineering is the technical authority of all the projects and has the perfect view if customer needs and requirements as well as market tendencies and lessons learned from existing projects.

Main Tasks & Responsabilities:

• Analysis, Accounting and planning of tasks and continuous monitoring of the results and allocated budget
• Collaborate with the SYS ML Head in preparing cost estimations and resource loading.
• Line Manager driving a team of signaling system engineers, whose main responsibilities are:
o Project requirements analysis at system level to provide the complete solution of the signaling system required by the project
o Definition of system-related functionalities to fulfil all project-specific needs, ensuring completeness of technical submission and consistency of the design
o Defining the system architecture according to the Siemens portfolio.
o Coordination with the head of R&D designated for the project
o Creation/Maintain of an URS (User Requirement Specification) to R&D capturing the gaps of the existing system to be applied against project requirements.
o Support to bidding team. Work with the different stakeholders involved in the bid process to ensure completeness in the proposed technical solution
o Support to system integration team to ensure a correct and complete integration between the different components of the signaling system and between the signaling system and the external parties.
• Motivation and development of employees both at management and professional levels.
• Evaluation of collaborators.

Requirements:

• Experience in a Rail Signaling.
• General knowledge in Railway Signaling and specifically in ML solution
• Knowledge in the Siemens Mobility portfolio for ML segment (ETCS)
• Desirable knowledge in other ML solutions (i.e: ASFA) and competitors portfolio
• Experience in Requirements Management, specification, traceability and validation.
• Desirable experience as a team leader
• Deep knowledge in CENELEC standards and V-life Cycle models
• Leadership, coaching and developing other abilities.
• Planning capabilities.
• +5 years experience as System manager or equivalent
• Availability to travel.
• Experience in international projects and experience in dealing with HQ.
• English and Spanish fluent
• Continuous improvement oriented

We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
In this role you will:
? Play the lead role in planning, executing, monitoring, controlling and rolling out key projects under our strategic programs, as well as tactical projects in response to more immediate business needs.

? The role is specifically focusing on projects within client´s operational departments and will be expected to deliver multiple complex projects on time, within the budget, and brief while keeping all stakeholders informed every step of the way.

? Typical projects identified to date that require management include, but are not limited to:
Docusign workflow creation and roll out; selection and implementation of a Quality Management System; selection and implementation of a data visualisation tool; GDPR enhancements and training.

You will act as chief motivator and expert planner for your team keeping everyone, including yourself, on task.

With a strong vision for the end goal and outcome, you must understand every step on the path to completing a project.

In... general, you will be responsible to:
? Define and clarify the project scope, including developing a project plan, budget, deliverables, and assess what is to be included or excluded from the project,

? Identify the project needs, including what resources, which team members, and any other departments that must be involved to deliver successfully,

? Participate in tender processes i. e. design, submission and review,

? Design and sign off on contracts

? Coordinate team effort, assign tasks, give direction to key project players, including Group Architecture, Group Cybersecurity, Group Infrastructure, local IT Stakeholders and Senior Stakeholders from across the business, as well as service providers - and keep everyone motivated

? Determine change management requirements for stakeholders and users and develop a change management strategy, plan and associated outputs

? Control and

document the progress of the project from start to finish, as well as evaluate each stage of the project and the end results,

? Produce regular status updates and key project updates in a variety of formats

? Oversee all incoming and outgoing project documentation,

? Optimize and improve processes and the overall approach where necessary.

? Attractive compensation package and career path|International environment

ESSENTIAL EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

? A degree in Engineering, IT or Computer Science, or similar.

? 6 to 10 years of prior relevant experience

? Must have experience in delivering operational technologies projects. Such as:
? A Quality Management System

? Approvals workflow tools

? Experience working cross-functionally on large projects,

? Excellent written and verbal communication skills, a cross functional team player with the ability to influence and persuade senior stakeholders

? Familiar with organizational change management including end user training and communication

? PMP, Prince2, ITIL certifications are a plus.

? Interpersonal skills

? Problem analysis & solving skills - analytical mind, critical thinking

? Teamwork & collaboration skills - ability to develop strong working relationships

? Hands-on - a keen eye for detail and desire to probe further into data

? Adaptability skills

? Business awareness

? Ability to stick to time constraints

? French or any other European language is a plus

jobs_results.title: IT Portfolio Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At LOEWE, we are looking for an exceptionally organized IT Portfolio Project Manager to join our innovative team. As the go-to for the IT Portfolio, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining a comprehensive IT Portfolio that meets the business needs of the company.The ideal candidate should have exceptional organizational skills, experience in project management and IT portfolio management, knowledge of IT project management processes and methodology, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. You should also have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.At LOEWE, we are looking for an individual who is passionate about their work, has a strong work ethic, and is an innovative problem-solver who is not afraid to take initiative. If you think you have what it takes to hit the ground running in this role and are excited to join a team of passionate professionals, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain a... comprehensive IT Portfolio that meets the business needs of the company.
Create and/or maintain project management processes and methodology.
Monitor progress of project deliverables and make adjustments as needed.
Establish and manage relationships with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Monitor IT portfolio performance and make necessary changes to ensure alignment with business goals and objectives.
Identify and assess risks associated with IT projects and develop strategies to mitigate those risks.
Prepare and deliver presentations and reports on IT portfolio performance.
Liaise with vendors to ensure successful delivery of IT projects.
Develop and implement best practices for IT portfolio management.
Stay abreast of the latest trends and technologies in the IT industry.

LOEWE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Consoleco S.L Spain, a thriving consulting company in the Information Technology and Services industry, is seeking a skilled and experienced IT Project Manager to join our team in Barcelona.

As an IT Project Manager, you will have the opportunity to drive innovation and work with global companies to improve their business output through strategic IT systems and applications. This is a fantastic opportunity to further develop your skills in a challenging environment and collaborate with other passionate IT professionals.

Responsibilities
• Lead and manage the full project lifecycle, from initiation to closure, ensuring successful delivery of IT projects.
• Define project scope, goals, and deliverables, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain project plans, including schedules, budgets, and resource allocation.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, analyse, and prioritise project requirements and risks.
• Monitor project progress... identify issues, and implement appropriate solutions to ensure project objectives are met.
• Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between project teams and clients.
• Track and report project status, including milestones, risks, and issues, to stakeholders and management.
• Barcelona Based.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience as an IT Project Manager, delivering complex IT projects on time and within budget.
• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
• Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage teams and interact with clients.
• Experience in Automotive domain
• Solid understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and technology infrastructure.
• Proficiency in project management tools and software.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• PMP certification or other relevant certifications preferred, but not required.
• Spain and English speaking - high level

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Who are we looking for?

You are a good fit if you like to coordinate between client, stakeholders and your team. We want you to be part of our team, if you are a good communicator, who knows how to identify customer requirements and manages future business solutions. Resting on your laurels is not familiar to you, nor is it for us.

What do we require?
• Focus on building & maintaining a strong relationship to our clients, respecting their needs and identifying business opportunities
• Experience in requirements management and ability to conceptualize the clients expectations
• Experience in managing medium size contracts and their budgets
• Having at least 1-2 years of experience as a Project Manager or equivalent position
• Ability to moderate workshops, presentations and discussions
• Documentation of complex topics concisely and comprehensibly
• Creating a communication plan and managing its execution
• Excellent... organizational and time management skills
• Acting as a trusted advisor for customers and colleagues
• With the input of the technical team, all technical topics can be discussed and explained to our clients
• Capability to manage a project team, including sub-contractors
• Business travel is not an issue for you
• Fluent (native level) Spanish
• Fluent English
• Eligibility to work within the EU

What makes us smile when looking at your profile
• Experience with Adobe CQ5 or AEM related web projects
• A proactive mind-set, ability to share your ideas and bring them to life
• Enthusiasm
• An open mind which is looking for continuous improvement
• Willingness to develop a stronger understanding of the projects technical components
• Receiving and giving feedback is familiar to you, something you are not afraid of

What we can offer you:
• Permanent contract
• 30 working days of vacation for all employees
• Flexible working hours, with respect to project needs
• Recognition bonus system
• Apple work equipment
• Continuous training and coaching
• Free language classes to polish your English or help you with your Spanish
• Truly international team
• Free Private health insurance
• Tax free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarden and transport)
• Sponsored gym membership
• A central office location closed to the Mercado Progreso
• Many off-site company events, including our annual company summits
• Everyone has a voice, we are a Holacracy organization
